text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon splendidly achieved 
outstanding results during her "initial 
three years" in the Twinkle Series.

On a peaceful day, after reaching that 
milestone—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Would you come to my family's home?

It was decided that I would visit Mihono 
Bourbon's family home.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There are two reasons.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One reason is that my father has always 
mentioned wishing to meet the Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since the racing schedule is relatively 
calm right now, I judged that going out 
wouldn't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The other one is—
—And Mihono Bourbon hesitated to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Because there are items that need to be 
verified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...We will arrive at the nearest station 
shortly. Please prepare to disembark."

—And the place she led me to was a rustic, 
solitary house in the countryside.

A kind-looking man was waiting at the 
front door.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Father. This is the Master.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about you. Thank you for taking 
such good care of my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry we couldn't visit the academy 
ourselves. It's a small place, but please 
make yourself at home."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Dad, here are the souvenirs you asked for.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thank you. So this is the rumored 
"Special Carrot Bread"...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Please make yourself comfortable. I'll 
bring over some drinks right now.

Looking around the room, a photo of a 
young Mihono Bourbon was displayed on the 
shelf.

Flashing a peace sign with an 
expressionless face while holding the 
number 1 flag was very Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Referencing data log. That is a photo from 
when I took 1st place for the very first 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was right around the time I started 
aiming for the Classic Triple Crown, so 
taking 1st place made me truly "happy."

Medals, trophies, and portraits Mihono 
Bourbon drew long ago were also on 
display—

"Among them, the thing that caught my eye 
was an old admission ticket from the day 
of the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is—unknown. It wasn't there before.

As Mihono Bourbon tilted her head in 
thought, her father appeared carrying a 
tea tray.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
—This is the ticket stub from the first 
time I took Bourbon to the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of my daughter's absence, 
I pulled these out. I'm such a doting 
parent, how embarrassing...
choice_data_list: It must be really precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
...After watching the race that day, this 
child declared that she wanted to become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
As you might know, she's not the type to 
go around saying she wants to do this or 
that, so—

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I was thrilled too. From that day on, the 
two of us started training together.

Bourbon had previously mentioned to me 
that her father used to train her when she 
was young.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—I have undergone rigorous training since 
childhood under my father, a former 
trainer. In other words, I am used to 
this.

Thanks to the habits formed in her youth, 
she possessed the foundational stamina and 
mental fortitude required to endure 
rigorous training.

"When I passionately shared how much 
strength that had given Mihono Bourbon, 
her father scratched his head in 
embarrassment."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: I haven't done anything special.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... you. I've wanted to 
thank you for so long.
choice_data_list: If anything, I've done nothing at all—

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
No, you made 'racing' mean something even 
greater to her than winning the Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen. Bourbon weeping tears 
of joy amidst thunderous applause—

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I was watching on TV, but... I just 
haven't been able to forget it since."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for raising my daughter so well, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Dad...

"—After relaxing there for a while, I took 
my leave."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking the time to meet with 
my father, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is rare to see Father speak so 
loquaciously. I presume he was quite 
pleased.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, what was it you 
wanted to check?

text_block_list.text:
On the way here, Mihono Bourbon mentioned 
that there was something she wanted to 
verify.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...That's, well... ...about the difference 
between Master and Father.

Caught completely off guard by her answer, 
I instinctively ask again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I used to think that Master resembled 
my father."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Because the way you respect my dream and 
walk alongside me was so very similar.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However—after going through the Arima 
Kinen, I felt that might not be the case.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"That day, as my emotions surged beyond 
projected parameters, I headed toward 
Master—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have realized that since meeting Master, 
my emotions have gained a slight range of 
variance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
These emotional swings are pleasant, a 
factor that enriches my life, and—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"When I realized that... I can't quite put 
it into words, but I felt you were 
different from my father."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Today, um... that's what I wanted to make 
sure of.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...There are many similarities. Someone 
who believes in me and continues to stand 
by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, it is definitely different. I 
cannot explain it well, but—
Mihono Bourbon looked straight at me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—You are Master. My one and only, very 
precious Master.

Perhaps due to the glow of the sunset, 
Mihono Bourbon's cheeks were faintly 
flushed with red.

And so, the days of walking alongside 
Mihono Bourbon began once more.
